name: Hieda Mai
source: Leader of the Mahjong Academy Cheering Team and captain of the Mahjong Bancho Guards. Former disciple of Kagami's father and the last line of defense before the Four Heavenly Kings. Always plays Mahjong with pompoms as a handicap.
